items.title: Bitcoin now counts as collateral: From the CFTC to the ECB
items.summary: The Daily Wolf host Scott Melker, the Wolf of All Streets, looks past the whiplash in global markets to the quieter changes in how Bitcoin and crypto are being used. Including new CFTC staff guidance letting exchanges count Bitcoin, ether and stablecoins toward their financial resource requirements, Cross River Bank launching Bitcoin-backed consumer loans of up to $250,000, and BTCS selling more than half its ether to repay an Aave loan in a warning sign for crypto treasury companies.

items.title: This Nasdaq ETF Pays a 19% Yield Without Writing a Single Covered Call. Here’s How
items.summary: A yield near 20% usually hides something. This Calamos fund swaps option writing for structured notes tied to the Nasdaq-100, and the fine print on barriers, skipped coupons, and a JPMorgan swap decides who really wins.

items.title: MINISO (MNSO) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher On Overseas Large Format Rollout
items.summary: The fair value estimate for MINISO Group Holding has been adjusted slightly higher, moving from US$14.16 to US$14.76 in the latest update. This shift comes as analysts factor in MINISO’s ongoing rollout of large format concepts overseas in 2026, including new MINISO LAND and SUPER MINISO locations in the U.S. and Canada. In the sections that follow, you will see how these valuation changes fit into the wider story and how to keep track of the evolving narrative around MINISO Group...
